_comment: Hosts fetch_source.py may download from: manufacturers and authoritative data sets only. NO retailers. Human-reviewed list; add a host only with a reason.

_reasons.store.tmotor.com: T-Motor, manufacturer store with spec tables
_reasons.m-selig.ae.illinois.edu: UIUC propeller data site, measured Ct/Cp
_reasons.holybro.com: Holybro, manufacturer (frames, flight controllers, GPS, power modules)
_reasons.docs.px4.io: PX4 project documentation of the Holybro/other autopilot hardware specs
_reasons.shop.tmotor.com: T-Motor, manufacturer shop (FPV products moved here from store.tmotor.com)
